rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 40 sites combined for the functional normative model reference cohort.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Data from 40 sites were combined to create the initial full sample."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Public datasets used in the reference cohort include ABCD, Cam-CAN, HCP, NKI-RS, PNC, UK Biobank, and CMI-HBN (HBN).
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Many sites were pulled from publicly available datasets including ABCD, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, NKI-RS, OpenNeuro, PNC, and UKBiobank."

rci3_epd_name.answer: ABCD; Cam-CAN; HCP; NKI; HBN; PNC; UK Biobank; OASIS; IXI; TOP
rci3_epd_name.detail: EPD names drawn from the listed public datasets and site names in Supplementary files 1 and 2.

rci5_n.detail: Training N for functional models summed across sites from Supplementary file 1 (training columns). Surface area N summed across sites from Supplementary file 2.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Supplementary file 1. Functional Normative Model Demographics.
